hero_eyebrow: A SMALL TEAM. A BIG WORLD.
hero_lead: We are Z_X Studios, an independent game development team building original interactive experiences and exploring the possibilities of connected worlds.
manifesto_title: We imagine more. Then build toward it.
manifesto_text: Z_X Studios is an independent development team focused on original games, ambitious simulations and detailed interactive environments. We are at the beginning of our journey: researching, planning and developing the foundations of our first major project.
project_teaser: An ambitious open-world life simulation concept built around one extraordinary idea: a world inspired by our own planet, ready to be explored.
disclaimer: LIFE ONLINE is in development. Descriptions on this website communicate the project's direction and goals; they are not a statement that these features are already implemented or available.
principle1_text: Research the places, objects and systems that make real environments feel authentic.
principle2_text: Break ambitious ideas into clear systems, practical experiments and achievable steps.
principle3_text: Test assumptions, welcome new knowledge and improve the work one iteration at a time.
closing_text: Follow the development journey as the ideas behind LIFE ONLINE take shape.
footer_note: Independent game development team. LIFE ONLINE is an original project in development.
studio_intro: An independent game development team with an ambitious outlook and a first project built around the scale and complexity of our world.
studio_heading: A development team with a world-sized idea.
studio_body: Z_X Studios is the name of an independent video game development team. We are creating original concepts and working toward LIFE ONLINE, a large-scale life simulation project. Our current work includes research, planning, design decisions and the early foundations required to move the project forward.
project_full_intro: A large-scale open-world life simulation concept inspired by the real world — its places, movement, systems and everyday experiences.
